DDL	CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS testdb
SESSION	USE testdb
DDL	CREATE TABLE t1(id INT, name STRING, value DOUBLE) USING PARQUET
DDL	CREATE TABLE t2(id INT, category STRING, amount BIGINT) USING CSV
DDL	CREATE TABLE t3(a INT, b STRING, c DOUBLE) USING ORC
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_name FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_path FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_size FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_modification_time FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.row_index FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_block_start FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_block_length FROM t1
READ	SELECT t1._metadata.file_name FROM t1
READ	SELECT testdb.t1._metadata.file_name FROM testdb.t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_name, t1._metadata.file_path FROM t1
READ	SELECT t1._metadata.file_name, testdb.t1._metadata.file_path FROM testdb.t1
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE _metadata.file_size > 1000
READ	SELECT id, name FROM t1 WHERE _metadata.row_index < 100
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE _metadata.file_name = 'data.parquet'
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE _metadata.file_modification_time > timestamp'2024-01-01 00:00:00'
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 WHERE t1._metadata.file_size > 1000
READ	SELECT * FROM testdb.t1 WHERE testdb.t1._metadata.row_index < 100
READ	SELECT id, name, _metadata.file_name FROM t1 ORDER BY _metadata.file_size
READ	SELECT * FROM t1 ORDER BY _metadata.row_index DESC
READ	SELECT id, _metadata.file_name FROM t1 ORDER BY _metadata.file_modification_time, _metadata.row_index
READ	SELECT t1._metadata.file_name, COUNT(*) FROM t1 GROUP BY t1._metadata.file_name
READ	SELECT testdb.t1._metadata.file_path, SUM(value) FROM testdb.t1 GROUP BY testdb.t1._metadata.file_path
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_name, MIN(_metadata.row_index), MAX(_metadata.row_index) FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_path, COUNT(DISTINCT _metadata.file_name) FROM t1
READ	SELECT t1.id, t2.category, t1._metadata.file_name
READ	SELECT t1.id, t1._metadata.file_name, t2._metadata.file_name
READ	SELECT t1.id, t1._metadata.row_index, t2._metadata.row_index
READ	SELECT t1.name, t1._metadata.file_name, t2._metadata.file_name
READ	SELECT t1._metadata.file_path, t2._metadata.file_path, t1.id
READ	SELECT t1._metadata.file_name, t2._metadata.file_name, t1.id, t2.id
READ	SELECT a.id, a._metadata.file_name, b._metadata.file_name
READ	SELECT t._metadata.file_name, t.id FROM t1 t
READ	SELECT x._metadata.file_name, x._metadata.row_index FROM t1 x
READ	SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, _metadata.file_name FROM t1) sub
READ	SELECT id FROM t1 WHERE _metadata.file_name IN
READ	SELECT _metadata.file_name, id FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.* FROM t1
READ	SELECT _metadata.* FROM t2
READ	SELECT _metadata.* FROM t3
READ	SELECT t1._metadata.* FROM t1
READ	SELECT t2._metadata.* FROM t2
READ	SELECT t3._metadata.* FROM t3
READ	SELECT id, name, _metadata.* FROM t1 ORDER BY id
READ	SELECT id, category, _metadata.* FROM t2 ORDER BY id
READ	SELECT sub.file_name, sub.file_size FROM (SELECT _metadata.* FROM t1) sub ORDER BY sub.file_name
READ	SELECT id, _metadata.* FROM t1 WHERE _metadata.file_size >= 0 ORDER BY id
READ	SELECT _metadata.*, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t1 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY _metadata.file_name
READ	SELECT _metadata.*, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t2 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY _metadata.file_name
READ	SELECT _metadata.*, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t3 GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY _metadata.file_name
DDL	DROP TABLE t1
DDL	DROP TABLE t2
DDL	DROP TABLE t3
DDL	DROP DATABASE testdb
